Package edu.cnu.mdi.sim

Interface SimulationListener

All Known Implementing Classes:
IconSimulationControlPanel, ImageEvolutionControlPanel, ImageEvolutionDemoView, NetworkDeclutterControlPanel, NetworkDeclutterDemoView, SimulationControlPanel, SimulationView, TspDemoControlPanel, TspDemoView
public interface SimulationListener
Listener interface for simulation lifecycle, state, UI refresh, and progress events.

All listener callbacks are executed on the AWT/Swing Event Dispatch Thread (EDT), so it is safe to update UI components directly inside these methods.

Implementers can override only the methods they care about; all methods are default no-ops.
